text: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，“十五五”时期，将着力以开放促改革发展，推进金融高水平对外开放。为此我们推进人民币国际化，加强金融基础设施跨境互联互通，发展人民币离岸市场，丰富离岸人民币流动性供给。
text_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei said that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, efforts will focus on promoting reform and development through opening up and advancing high-level financial opening up. To this end, we will promote RMB internationalization, strengthen cross-border interconnection of financial infrastructure, develop the offshore RMB market, and enrich the supply of offshore RMB liquidity.
